mbm-2386.clue: The cloud was shaped like the kettle at home.
mbm-2386.quote: I expected the jump to empty my mind. Under my open canopy I saw a fat white cloud with a spout and thought I'd put the kettle on for Mum when I got back.

mbm-2387.clue: Our baduk bowls have mismatched lids.
mbm-2387.quote: My grandmother and I traded lids when I moved away. Mine sits a little crooked. Whenever I hear it rattle I picture her opposite me, pretending she hasn't seen my trap.

mbm-2388.clue: I never saw the coin land.
mbm-2388.quote: I tossed it toward my scarf and it slid straight into my sister's slipper. She kept her face perfectly still and turned out the slipper after my bow. We split the applause.

mbm-2389.clue: The fastest thing on the table was the judge's pencil.
mbm-2389.quote: Our dumpling contest went to a tie. I made my last dumpling a tiny paper crown out of the napkin before I ate it. The judge drew it beside my name.

mbm-2390.clue: The disc comes home wearing socks.
mbm-2390.quote: I threw it on top of our clothesline and down it came with two socks draped over it. My cousin caught the whole bundle. We call that shot a clean catch.

mbm-2391.clue: My paint box is a terrible place to keep a biscuit.
mbm-2391.quote: I painted the same biscuit tin every Tuesday until I could get the dents right without looking. One afternoon my teacher opened it and found my spare brushes. She said she'd waited six weeks for a biscuit. I brought shortbread to the next class.

mbm-2392.clue: One ski pole wears a bracelet.
mbm-2392.quote: My daughter braided wool around the grip before our trip. I can find my poles in a crowded rack from the chairlift. She takes credit for every tidy turn I make.

mbm-2393.clue: My initials are the bit that goes against the wall.
mbm-2393.quote: I made a leather sling to carry our picnic bottle. My first crooked stamp sits underneath where it rests against the basket. On the way home my friend turned the bottle upside down and toasted the artist.

mbm-2394.clue: The castle keeps my old button.
mbm-2394.quote: I banked a mini-golf shot off the castle gate and a button popped off my jacket. The owner set it into the fence like a coat of arms. I visit my castle every birthday.

mbm-2395.clue: I bowl with a very patient crocodile.
mbm-2395.quote: My young nephew paints animals on my score sheet. Three straight gutter balls make the crocodile longer. I had my best night just when he needed one more tooth.

mbm-2396.clue: I made enough room for our knees.
mbm-2396.quote: We held our first winter quilting bee under two pushed-together tables to see why our knees kept getting cold. The blanket we'd made stopped at the edges. I quilted a wide flounce around it and we all sewed the last inch from inside our fort.

mbm-2397.clue: I borrowed the baker's hat for one afternoon.
mbm-2397.quote: I pretended to pull a pretzel through a solid ribbon at the farmers market. The baker tied a second pretzel onto the free end without my seeing. That was lunch sorted.

mbm-2398.clue: My aunt's porch has the best music teacher.
mbm-2398.quote: My nephew wanted a turn with my claves during our son session. He struck them faster and faster until I pointed at my aunt rocking on the porch swing. He waited for the creak and slipped right back into the tune. Now he saves me a seat by his elbow.

mbm-2399.clue: My oranges go round the world.
mbm-2399.quote: I stuck fruit labels from different countries on three juggling balls. My niece names each place as it passes. She says I need to slow down over the ocean.

mbm-2400.clue: The good shoes have a flour print.
mbm-2400.quote: My partner and I practiced a slow foxtrot in the bakery before opening. One white footprint stayed on my shoe. I wore it to our first dance so my feet would remember the kitchen.
